name: hud_cmd_dialog_state_queue_enter
description: HudCmdDialogState::QueueEnter queues the global HUD command dialog state on the global RecoilApp state queue with suspend parameter 0.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HudCmdDialogState/HudCmdDialog source-file cluster. Current source preserves the observed QueuePushState call target and parameter; exact VC5SP3 byte comparison remains a later pass.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja evidence for 0x40bda0 shows push 0, push 0x4e5df0 (&g_HudCmdDialogState), ECX=0x4f3ca8 (&g_RecoilApp), call RecoilApp::QueuePushState, and return.

Native smoke zhud_cmd_dialog_state_queue_enter_smoke installs a test OnEnter vtable on g_HudCmdDialogState, calls HudCmdDialogState::QueueEnter, and verifies one queued PushState item targeting g_HudCmdDialogState with parameter 0 and one immediate OnEnter dispatch from RecoilApp::QueuePushState.
